description: A simulated situation for learning anything: languages, tourism, customer service, etc. The rubric in the module is the source of truth for evaluation — no domain is hardcoded in the server.

domain.description: Free-form domain slug. Common values: language, tourism, customer-service, healthcare, sales, interview. Any new domain works — the server never switches on it.

hints.description: Short hints shown to the learner before/during the situation.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the language being practised, e.g. en, es, fr, ja

keywords.description: Optional hints for the stub/heuristic evaluator and for human authors. The LLM evaluator uses the description, not only these words.

required.description: If true, the situation cannot be completed unless this objective is met.

passThreshold.description: Weighted score (0-1) needed to complete the situation.

scale.description: Max score per criterion, e.g. 5 means each criterion is scored 0-5.

successCriteria.description: Human-readable summary of what 'done' means, e.g. 'Order a drink, pay, and say goodbye politely.'

systemPrompt.description: System instruction for the AI persona. Must tell it to stay in character, keep answers short, and reply in the target language.

title: Situ — Situation Module
